title: Integer-valued REAL selectBytes fast path
impact: Adds a conservative `SQLITE_FLOAT` JSON helper that routes finite, exactly integral REAL values inside the exact double integer range (`abs(v) <= 2^53`) through the existing `fast_i64_to_str` path while preserving `snprintf("%.17g")` for fractional values, huge values, non-finite values, and negative zero. Focused `select_bytes_real_int_fastpath.dart` A/B (order-flipped pair): **10k x 8 integral REAL -79%, 10k x 20 integral REAL -81%, 1k x 2 integral REAL -72%**, with the fractional-REAL fallback guard flat at +0.5% and the mixed lane moving in proportion to its integral-REAL columns. No public API change; new selectBytes test covers integral REAL, fractional REAL, and huge fallback values.
